caption: The drawing shows a woman standing at the center, holding her hands in front of her chest, with a large sword positioned diagonally across her body and resting against her left shoulder. She has a halo around her head and is wearing a long red gown with a green outer cloak that has decorative patterns along the edges. The background of the image appears cracked and worn, with a light beige color and sections of missing or peeling pigment, exposing the underlying surface. The border of the rectangular frame is dark brown and similarly weathered, with the top corners showing damage. There are simple plant motifs on either side of her at the bottom foreground, featuring spiky leaves. Draped red and yellow fabric or banners are shown at the upper corners within the frame. The style is flat and outlined in dark black lines, with visible brushstrokes in the coloring.
title: Retablo
